page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance built on KVM hypervisor technology. It is driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, configured with 8 virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. System memory totals 32 GB, providing a standard ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps and offers no local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in lower tiers relative to modern compute hardware. Single-core stress-ng benchmarks place execution performance in the bottom 10 percent, while multi-core stress-ng and PassMark CPU tests fall within the bottom 25 percent. Uncached memory write speeds register at 25.34 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput measures 6.06 GB/sec. These results reflect the compute limits of the underlying Broadwell architecture and legacy GPU platform.

The hardware configuration represents an entry-level GPU option, trading high-end CPU and memory throughput for cost-conscious hardware acceleration. The absence of local storage makes storage performance dependent on network volume configuration. Best-fit workloads for this server type include lightweight machine learning model inference, image processing, legacy video transcoding, and small-scale graphics tasks.
